units.source_text: 这时候世人把内大臣家新来的小姐当作话柄，凡有所闻，必纷纷宣扬。

en.t: At this time, people everywhere made the new young lady at the Minister of the Interior's house a subject of gossip, and whatever they heard, they eagerly spread abroad.

units.source_text: 源氏听到此种消息，说道：“不管这样或那样，总而言之，

en.t: When Genji heard such reports, he said, "Whatever the rights and wrongs of it may be, in the end,

units.source_text: 把从来没人见过的一个深闺女子找出来，

en.t: to seek out a sheltered young woman whom no one had ever seen before,

units.source_text: 当作千金小姐看待，稍有缺点，

en.t: treat her as a precious daughter of high rank, and then, at the slightest flaw,

units.source_text: 便逢人诉苦，以致引起谣传，

en.t: complain of his troubles to everyone he meets until rumors begin to spread,

units.source_text: 内大臣这种作风真不可解！

en.t: the Minister of the Interior's way of doing things is truly impossible to understand!

units.source_text: 此人过分察察为明，加之思虑疏忽，

en.t: The man is far too sharp-eyed about trifles, and on top of that his judgment is careless,

units.source_text: 不曾调查清楚，贸然接了她来。

en.t: so without investigating matters properly, he rashly took her into his household.

units.source_text: 一有不称心处，便闹得不成样子。

en.t: As soon as anything displeases him, he makes a disgraceful commotion of it.

units.source_text: 其实世间万事都可从长计议，妥善处理。”

en.t: In truth, everything in this world can be considered at length and handled with care."

units.source_text: 他很可怜那近江君。

en.t: He felt great pity for that Lady Omi.

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了这话，想道：“我还算运气好，

en.t: Tamakazura heard these words and thought, "I was fortunate after all,

units.source_text: 不曾去投靠父亲。

en.t: not to have gone and placed myself under my father's protection.

units.source_text: 虽说是生身之父，但一向不知道他的性情，

en.t: Though he is my real father, I have never known what kind of temperament he has,

units.source_text: 蓦地去亲近他，或许也要受辱呢。”

en.t: and if I had suddenly tried to draw close to him, I too might have been humiliated."

units.source_text: 她深自庆幸。

en.t: She felt deeply thankful for her good fortune.

units.source_text: 右近也就此事对她说了许多话。

en.t: Ukon also spoke with her at length about this matter.

units.source_text: 源氏对于玉鬘，虽然怀着那可恨的野心，

en.t: As for Genji, although he harbored those blameworthy desires toward Tamakazura,

units.source_text: 然而并无任情而动的非礼行为，

en.t: he never behaved improperly by acting on impulse,

units.source_text: 只是对她的怜爱越来越深。

en.t: and only his tender affection for her grew deeper and deeper.

units.source_text: 因此玉鬘也渐渐地亲近他，无所顾虑了。

en.t: For that reason, Tamakazura too gradually became closer to him and no longer felt any reserve.
